chunks: And by this chain, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no cutting (of the hand) upon the one who stole stones, meaning marble and similar to that.
ai.seo_question: Who is exempt from hand amputation for theft according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights a nuanced juristic distinction where the theft of building materials like marble (rukhām) does not trigger the standard hand amputation (qat' al-yad). This ruling reflects the scholarly understanding that such materials, while valuable, may not meet the specific criteria of 'gold and silver' or typical portable wealth required for the hadd punishment, emphasizing the precision of Shia fiqh in categorizing stolen goods.
